title: Java vs Python
shortAnswer: Java is a statically typed, compiled language that dominates enterprise software, Android development, and large-scale backend systems. Python is dynamically typed, easier to learn, and leads in AI/ML. Java runs faster; Python is written faster.
verdict: Java for enterprise, Android, and performance. Python for AI/ML, data science, and rapid development. Both are top-5 global programming languages.

lines.hook: Java or Python? The numbers settle it.
lines.tape: Five categories. One winner. Here is how they actually compare.
rounds: On typing system, it is dead even.
